featured.title: Wave Forcing: Towards Speed-of-Light Streaming Video Generation
featured.tldr: Wave Forcing lets several video chunks denoise at once on different GPUs, with earlier chunks serving as cleaner context for later ones, reaching about 135 end-to-end frames per second on eight H200 GPUs.

featured.title: Looking Ahead: Modeling Future Evolution in Autoregressive Video Generation
featured.tldr: Future Chunk Prediction adds a training-only auxiliary task to autoregressive video diffusion, predicting chunks several steps ahead, which improves physical plausibility without changing inference.

featured.title: Speculative Forcing for Efficient Autoregressive Video Generation
featured.tldr: Speculative Forcing freezes video tokens as soon as a verifier predicts their denoising has converged, matching four-step quality in about 1.7 steps and running over 1.5 times faster.

featured.title: GRACE: Generation-aware latent compression for efficient video generation
featured.tldr: GRACE shrinks the token count of a pretrained video diffusion model nearly eightfold by compressing its autoencoder in a way the diffusion model still understands, cutting latency 11.1 times with no VBench loss.

featured.title: DuoMatching: Joint-Marginal Distribution Matching for Few-Step Video Generation
featured.tldr: DuoMatching adds an image generator as a second teacher in video distillation, supervising each frame separately, which improves detail and prompt adherence in few-step streaming video generation without extra inference cost.
